newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rocker Love can thank Czech's Havel for acting job.
newsitem.headline: Rocker Love can thank Czech's Havel for acting job.

text.p: Controversial punk rock singer Courtney Love got a starring role in the film "The People vs Larry Flynt" at the urging of Czech President Vaclav Havel, director Milos Forman said on Saturday.

Forman, whose film had its international premiere at the Berlin Film Festival, said he picked Love despite her lack of acting experience from a field of 60 candidates after showing screen tests of three finalists to Havel, his friend in Prague.
"I had three finalists and was leaning towards Courtney but I wasn't completely sure," the Czech-born Forman said.
"I showed the screen tests to Vaclav and his wife Olga. They strongly and enthusiastically voted for Courtney."
Havel, a playwright and leading dissident before becoming president seven years ago, recently remarried after his first wife Olga died last year of cancer.
Love, the widow of rock star Kurt Cobain, has had numerous and well-publicised scrapes with the law in the United States, the Netherlands and Australia in recent years.
Among other things, she has assaulted fans at her concerts, been arrested for drug-related charges and been charged with unruly behaviour on an airliner.

"Of the 60 who auditioned for the part, there were 59 professional actresses who came and the only one who came to the first meeting and knew the whole script by heart was the rock and roll diva named Courtney Love," Forman said.
